# NewEdenKit.ESI

> Typed .NET client for EVE Online's ESI API (https://esi.evetech.net), generated from ESI's OpenAPI spec. One
> injectable service per ESI tag (IAssets, ICharacter, IMarket, …), one method per ESI operation, every call returns
> EsiResult<T> and never throws for HTTP errors. Caching, ETags and other cross-cutting behaviour are opt-in
> middleware. .NET 8/9/10, trim and AOT compatible, Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.

Quick start (`dotnet add package NewEdenKit.ESI`):

<!-- snippet: register -->
```csharp
services.AddEveEsi(o =>
    {
        o.ApplicationName = "MyApp/1.2";      // your app, sent in the User-Agent (required)
        o.Contact = "admin@example.com";      // how CCP can reach you (required)
    })
    .EnableCaching();                         // optional: response cache + ETags, in a local folder
```

<!-- snippet: quickstart -->
```csharp
// Inject a service (IAssets, ICharacter, IMarket, …), build the request, execute it.
var result = await assets.GetCharactersCharacterIdAssets(characterId, accessToken, page: 1).ExecuteAsync(ct);
if (result.IsSuccess)
{
    foreach (var asset in result.Value) { total += asset.Quantity; }
}
else
{
    // Never throws for HTTP errors: inspect result.StatusCode and result.Error (Kind, Message).
}
```

Key facts:
- Services are in `NewEdenKit.ESI.Services`; models in `NewEdenKit.ESI.Models.<Tag>`; results in `NewEdenKit.ESI.Abstractions.Results`.
- Method names are ESI operation IDs (`GET /markets/{region_id}/orders` → `IMarket.GetMarketsRegionIdOrders`). Each
  method's XML docs give its HTTP method, path and required scope.
- Secured endpoints take the SSO access token as a `string` parameter; obtaining tokens is up to the application.
- Page-based endpoints take `int? page` (total in `result.Headers.Pages`); cursor-based ones take `CursorPage? cursor`.
- IDs are `long`. Enums have `Unknown = 0`; unions have an `Unknown` variant. Check `IsSuccess` before `Value`.
- Never use a raw HttpClient for ESI, and never set User-Agent / X-Compatibility-Date / X-Tenant yourself.

## Docs

- [Usage guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EveOnline-Net/NewEdenKit.ESI/main/docs/usage.md): registration, finding
  the method for an endpoint, calls and tokens, results and errors, pagination, bodies, caching, middleware, types,
  testing, and common mistakes. Every example in it is compiled in CI.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EveOnline-Net/NewEdenKit.ESI/main/README.md): overview and packages.

## Optional

- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EveOnline-Net/NewEdenKit.ESI/main/docs/architecture.md): how requests

- [Design decisions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EveOnline-Net/NewEdenKit.ESI/main/docs/design-decisions.md): why
